tools.Name: MinerU
tools.Description: An open-source solution for precise document content extraction, transforming complex documents like PDFs and Office files into LLM-ready markdown/JSON.
tools.Use_Case: Extracting structured data from PDFs, scanned documents, and Office files for RAG pipelines or agentic workflows.

tools.Name: Browser-Use
tools.Description: An open-source library that enables AI agents to navigate the web, perform tasks, and interact with websites like a human.
tools.Use_Case: Automating complex web tasks such as booking appointments, filling forms, and gathering data from sites that require interactivity.

tools.Name: Mem0
tools.Description: A persistent, intelligent memory layer for AI agents that remembers user preferences and adapts over time.
tools.Use_Case: Personalizing AI assistant interactions by retaining context, preferences, and history across multiple sessions.
